purpose: Compare three existing pages using contract v1 without a library rollout
direction: Toward the literature: remove overclaims and preserve exact scope; no certification convenience or threshold change
selection_method: Purposive pilot, not a systematic review: existing source links and data already used on cadmium, rice and non-soy powder formula. Select the two FDA occurrence datasets for reproducible basis/censoring examples, two existing rice intervention studies for control/trade-off examples, EFSA for authority context and EU for a dated basis-comparison example. All remaining legacy candidates are not screened, not excluded. Duplicate sync copies are not independent evidence.
protocol_note: Design and selection were recorded during this pilot; not prospectively registered. Searches used to recover public originals of already-ingested sources, not to claim coverage of new literature.

source_checks.limits: Direct occurrence only; products analyzed as sold, converted by FDA to prepared-for-feeding; water contribution assumed zero; numerical values include estimates between LOD and LOQ. LOD and LOQ may vary. No market weights or paired ingredient measurements.

deduplication.FDA_special_survey: one dataset family; 230 selected products per analyte, not 920 independent products
deduplication.FDA_TDS: one dataset family; prepared-food composites, repeated across analytes; iAs separate count
deduplication.irrigation: one experiment family; repeated mesocosms over two years
deduplication.cooking: one paper; its experiments and cited papers not counted as separate replications of a general effect
deduplication.legacy_candidates: Unscreened; duplicate publications and overlapping datasets not yet adjudicated

appraisal.occurrence: Basis, analyte, count and censoring checked in selected records. Market representativeness and analytical uncertainty not fully appraised. No pooled distribution.
appraisal.interventions: Comparator, matrix, scale and cross-contaminant limits recorded; full risk-of-bias, precision, replication and commercial-transfer appraisal unfinished.
appraisal.health: Authority context only; no new body-of-evidence assessment.
appraisal.legal: Dated primary provisions checked; not current all-jurisdiction completeness.
appraisal.certainty: Not assessed; no source-count or source-tier grades.

conflicts_of_interest: HMI is operated in the same organizational context as the certification program described in repository governance. This pilot changes no certification limits and makes no brand endorsements. Human reviewer and source-level funding/COI appraisal remain unfinished.

relative_findings_extension.scope: Descriptive comparisons within the existing FDA source subsets
relative_findings_extension.input_reconciliation: Sample register matches reconciled artifact hash and each pilot food/analyte summary count, detection count and detected range.
relative_findings_extension.formula_censoring: Primary PDF inspected, analyte footnotes on pages 1/8/15/22. Source-wide prepared-for-feeding LOD maxima conservatively bound <LOD; individual LODs are not inferred.
relative_findings_extension.limits: Historical sampled collections; matched strata do not establish population trends. No question-level review completion, new safety threshold or library rollout.

mitigation_extension.scope: End-to-end rice supply-chain pilot for ingredient suppliers, brands and consumers, with applicable rice Cd controls on Cadmium. Selected evidence, not a completed review.

rice_form_comparison_extension.scope: Descriptive brown/white comparisons only; existing verified source measurements unchanged.
rules: FDA cooked foods: same analyte, collection year, region and season; equally weighted collection-group medians. Different composites, not paired grain or causal milling effects.

Tran: explicitly verified same-plant 184-genotype brown/white design; same statistic, species, preparation basis and counted unit. Compare reported rounded means without inferred individual effects, CIs or significance.
No cross-study rice-type pool; unmeasured comparator species remain unavailable, and non-detect bounds are preserved.
rice_form_comparison_extension.certainty: No new certainty rating, review-completion or supplier-ranking claim.
